branding.cobranded: A PSA & Blue & White Finance Game

level1.title: The Little Saver
level1.subtitle: Ages 6–8
level1.description: Learn to save and spend wisely at the makolet!
level1.intro: Welcome! You can earn shekalim by helping out around the house. Do chores, get paid, then head to the makolet — but choose wisely! Candy is yummy but it's gone fast. Save up for something bigger!

level2.title: The School Year Budget
level2.subtitle: Ages 9–11
level2.description: Manage your weekly pocket money through the school year.
level2.intro: You get weekly pocket money from your parents. But there are tiyulim, school supplies, and Purim is coming! Can you budget wisely?

level3.title: The Part-Time Worker
level3.subtitle: Ages 12–14
level3.description: Earn your own money and learn to manage it.
level3.intro: You've got your first job! Whether it's babysitting, tutoring, or delivering — this money is yours to manage. Plan for yom tov weeks when you can't work.

level4.title: The Road to Independence
level4.subtitle: Ages 15–17
level4.description: Manage a bank account, invest, and prepare for the future.
level4.intro: You're almost independent! Open a bank account, learn about investing, and plan for your gap year or army prep. Big decisions start now.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.greeting: Nice to meet you, {{name}}! Here's how you'll earn and spend your shekalim:
howItWorks.step1text: Each day you'll see a chore board. Pick up to 3 chores — easy ones pay ₪1, hard ones pay up to ₪4!
howItWorks.step2text: Finish your chores and collect your shekalim. The harder you work, the more you earn!
howItWorks.step3text: Head to the shop! You can buy snacks (yummy but gone fast) or save up for bigger things like toys and games.
howItWorks.step4text: Set a saving goal for something special. It might take a few days of hard work — but that's what makes it worth it!
howItWorks.tip: Remember: you don't have to spend everything you earn. Sometimes the smartest move is to save for tomorrow!

chores.title: Chore Board
chores.instructions: Pick up to {{max}} chores to earn shekalim today!

level2HowItWorks.title: How It Works
level2HowItWorks.greeting: Hi {{name}}! Here's how to manage your school year budget:
level2HowItWorks.step1text: Every Sunday you receive ₪50 pocket money — your budget for the whole week!
level2HowItWorks.step2text: Each week you'll face real decisions — buy school supplies? Go to pizza with friends? Get that cool toy? You choose what matters!
level2HowItWorks.step3text: Keep your Happiness 😊, Friends 👫, and Money 💰 meters all healthy. Skip friends too often and they'll notice. Spend on everything and you'll go broke!
level2HowItWorks.step4text: Get through the whole school term without going broke or letting your happiness crash. Balance is the key!
level2HowItWorks.tip: You can't have everything — but you can be smart about what you pick!

level3HowItWorks.title: How It Works
level3HowItWorks.greeting: Hey {{name}}! You've got your first part-time job. Here's how this works:
level3HowItWorks.step1text: Choose from babysitting, tutoring, or delivery. Each pays differently and has different hours available.
level3HowItWorks.step2text: Each week, pick which days you'll work. More shifts = more income — but no working on Shabbat!
level3HowItWorks.step3text: Your phone bill is ₪50/month — non-negotiable! Then split what's left between transport, food, savings, and fun.
level3HowItWorks.step4text: Complete 4 months with positive balance AND reach your savings goal. Yom Tov weeks mean less income — plan ahead!
level3HowItWorks.tip: Yom Tov weeks mean ZERO income. If you don't save during regular weeks, you'll struggle when the holidays come!
